newsitem.title: USA: Patrick board still reviewing proposal.
newsitem.headline: Patrick board still reviewing proposal.

text.p: Patrick Industries Inc said Thursday it still was considering a proposal for the acquisition of the company.
The maker of building products announced July 3 that it and a major shareholder had received a proposal for the acquisition of all of the company's shares.
"Although there are no assurances that any agreement will be reached, discussions are continuing, and the board of directors is still considering the proposal," the company said in a statement.
Further details were not disclosed. Patrick's stock was down 1/2 at 18-1/2 in afternoon trade.
